channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Denim Tears Reclaims Forgotten Symbols of Liberty (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Denim Tears Spring/Summer 2026 is both a new range of graphic gear and a lesson on the untold history behind the Statue of Liberty.

item.title: Even on the Darkest Days, Nike’s Flawlessly Faded Forces Look Good
item.description: Nike's Air Force 1 Low "Dark Sky Blue" sneaker makes gloomy colors look suave (& suede-ish).

item.title: Nike's Dotted Air Max Is Even Better as a Trail Sneaker
item.description: Nike's Air Max Plus VII "Iron Grey" sneakers feature trail-worthy shoelaces. Now, they're practically hike-able.

item.title: This $8,000 Hand-Chiseled Watch Is the Rolex of G-SHOCKs
item.description: All 800 of Casio’s new MRG-B2000KT-3A watches are carefully chiseled into shape by one man: Third-generation Japanese metalsmith Kobayashi Masao.

item.title: Nike’s All-Leather Air Jordans Are Almost Too Elegant for On & Off the Court
item.description: The Air Jordan 6 "Bin 23" restarts a luxe tradition, arriving as a quality leather version of the classic basketball sneaker.

item.title: adidas’ Sporty Mary Jane Sneaker Is a Part-Time Ballerina, Full-Time Stunner
item.description: adidas' Barreda Mary Jane sneakers are the brand's other cutesy, sporty ballet-style sneakers, offered in classic colorways & textural designs.

item.title: adidas Lux'd Up the Samba. Now, It's a Dapper Dress Shoe
item.description: adidas' Samba Lux Freizeit lands in all-black leather for its debut. Here's everything on the chunky dress sneaker.

item.title: How Do You Make Denim Look Like Leather?
item.description: Levi's and BIOTOP have tweaked the first-ever denim jacket, the Levi’s Type I, by turning its denim body into (faux) leather.

item.title: Vans' Luxe Leather Zip-Ups Aren't Meant to Be Worn. They're Meant to Be Fastened
item.description: The Vans Old Skool Zip Shoe exalts the beauty of the Old Skool silhouette, framing it in a new set of premium fabrics and adding a zip along the laces.

item.title: Mercedes-AMG's adidas Handball Spezial Went Full Tiffany & Co.
item.description: adidas' Handball Spezial sneaker is a fabulously flat sneaker that took a quick trip to Tiffany & Co.
